title: Immaculate Constellation search spike and its deletion from Google Trends
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Immaculate Constellation search spike and its deletion from Google Trends, about 2023-2024 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh Immaculate Constellation had like a search spike when David Grush came out in I think August or September of 2023.

plain: Immaculate Constellation is the name of an alleged secret US programme on unexplained craft, raised by a journalist, Michael Shellenberger, in testimony at a November 2024 congressional hearing. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the name had a spike in searches on Google Trends, Google's tool showing how often terms are searched, around August or September 2023, when a whistleblower named David Grusch went public, and that this data was later deleted. If true, it would suggest people knew the name long before it was public, and that someone wanted that trace gone.
